method: traced actual runtime selection logic, not names or comments
decisive_measurement: The ONLY outbound HTTP calls in app/modules, app/api and services are in payments adapters (tap_adapter.js, hyperpay_adapter.js). There are ZERO outbound calls to any government or regulator API.

integrations.name: Qiwa
integrations.evidence: QiwaMappingService (app/modules/compliance/qiwa_mapping_service.js) is 17 lines and pure: it renames contract fields (employee_name, job_title, base_salary, allowances, probation_days). No client, no credential, no network. 'Qiwa Ready' / 'Qiwa readiness' badges derive from validateQiwaCompleteness(), a local required-field presence check in contract_state_machine.js.

integrations.name: GOSI
integrations.evidence: Appears only in policy config JSON and UI copy. No adapter, no client, no call path.

integrations.name: Mudad
integrations.evidence: Appears only in UI copy and brand regulator lists. No adapter, no client, no call path.

integrations.name: VERITAS
integrations.evidence: Internal evidence/event forwarding plus a CI gate workflow (veritas_forwarder_gate.yml). No outbound client found.

integrations.name: HyperPay
integrations.evidence: Real adapter with fetch() to /checkouts and /payments. HYPERPAY_ENV selects sandbox vs production and DEFAULTS TO 'production'. Production path asserts HYPERPAY_ENTITY_ID / ACCESS_TOKEN / WEBHOOK_SECRET and throws MISSING_CREDENTIALS when absent. Live fund movement is contained by CREDENTIAL ABSENCE (DL-096), not by mode configuration.

integrations.name: Tap
integrations.evidence: Second payment adapter with fetch() to /charges, /refunds, /transfers. Present in the reverse walk; not named in the run brief's integration list.

integrations.name: ERP
integrations.evidence: No ERP adapter or client. Raw substring hits are inflated by 'erp' occurring inside unrelated words; no integration exists.

public_claim_under_review.claim: GOSI, Mudad, Qiwa integrations via licensed partners
public_claim_under_review.reasoning: The wording is deliberately hedged: trust_band.js states 'Regulator integration is via licensed partners' and carries a disclaimer naming what is NOT claimed (SAMA licensing, NCA ECC certification); payroll.js states 'Payroll execution is partner-mediated ... No payment is initiated from this surface.' So the copy does not assert a direct WorkCaptain-to-Qiwa integration, and the absence of a direct client does not falsify it. However NO partner adapter, partner configuration or partner linkage exists in the repository either, so the claim is not substantiated here.
public_claim_under_review.remediation: NOT REMEDIATED. Rewriting customer-facing marketing/positioning copy is a Sponsor/brand decision, not a code-only defect fix. Recorded as UNDER_ADJUDICATION rather than changed unilaterally.
